# Synthetic metadata packet fixtures

These 31 packets were constructed with Python protobuf 6.31.0 from the unchanged embedded FileDescriptorSet. They are schema and wire-contract fixtures; they are not captured camera packets, Windows outputs or evidence of DJI conversion behavior. `manifest.json` records every wire byte, SHA-256, selected package, selected expectations and independent Python acceptance/error.

Reproduction requires Python protobuf 6.31.0. From the source root, run `python3 tests/fixtures/metadata/generate.py`; use `--output-dir PATH` to reproduce into another owned directory. The reconstruction workspace already has a compatible wheel; run `python3 tests/fixtures/metadata/generate.py --protobuf-wheel ../../tools/ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC/Ghidra/Debug/Debugger-rmi-trace/pypkg/dist/protobuf-6.31.0-py3-none-any.whl` from this author worktree. No global package installation is needed. The script asserts the recovered descriptor hash before producing anything.

The complete OQB101 and WAB530 cases cover distinct pano/extri/camera field numbers, both lenses, packed float coefficients, clip/frame uint64 values above 2^53, uint32 attitude timestamps, repeated quaternions, camera acceleration, raw WAB530 samples, optional-message presence, and unknown fields in nested header/quaternion messages. Quaternion values are deliberately raw components rather than a normalized physical orientation. Camera timestamps remain independent integers with unknown units. Unknown-field variants include varint, fixed32, fixed64, length-delimited and group fields. Original bytes are authoritative even where duplicate singular messages merge or a noncanonical varint normalizes after re-encoding.

Malformed probes check truncated/invalid keys, values and lengths, nested failures, invalid UTF-8, malformed tails, group errors, excessive group recursion and known-field wrong wire types. The locked native runtime rejects all 16 probes. The independent pure-Python runtime accepts three: overflowing uint64 varint, 101 recursively nested unknown groups, and legal varint wire type at a known message-field number. Those are explicitly recorded native runtime policies and are not claims about vendor acceptance. The dependency recursion guard is retained, and the caller supplies a wire-size limit separately from decoded-memory use.

The implementation contract and Astra approval are recorded in `sol-review/resumed-metadata-20261010/CONTRACT.md`, bus messages 52/56. Independent Luna field mapping and corrected wire vectors are under `luna-review/instance-a/resumed-metadata-20261010/`; the initial filename-wrapping discrepancy and correction are preserved in bus 59/64 and `sol-review/resumed-metadata-20261010/luna-fixture-oracle.json`. The Rust tests here use freshly generated Python descriptor fixtures.
